frozen_before: any challenger prediction for a 2026 game was computed or compared with an outcome or with production. Built before freezing: the extended dataset (feature/outcome table, not scored), the two production tables (forecast selection only).
untouched_check: cfb_game_lines_v1 scored dev 2017-21, test 2022-24 and holdout 2025 only (holdout.json seasons == [2025]); no 2026 game was ever scored by the study, so 2026 is untouched for this comparison.

dataset.builder: alpha_engine.discovery.cfb_production_h2h build = features.cfb_cfbd_v2 (certified v2.2) over the vault CFBD cache 2014-2026 (archive v1-292f3aac) + 2026 final scores / kickoff from the vault ESPN postgame summaries 2026 (collected-20261116), joined on the shared ESPN/CFBD game id with a home/away ESPN team-id check
dataset.extent: 751 final 2026 games, 2026-08-29..2026-11-15 UTC (2026-11-14 ET); 137 scheduled games not final at collection
dataset.known_limitation: The CFBD 2026 cache holds no advanced box, no drives and no betting lines (games, talent, recruiting, returning production, portal, coaches, rankings only), and no other archive or cfb-edge-finder branch holds them. Every in-season feature of a 2026 game is therefore computed from 2025 games inside the builder's 400-day window (stale; 2026 in-season form is invisible to the challenger). Priors are the published 2026 preseason values. The challenger is information-starved relative to production by construction; this is the challenger as archived data supports it, not the study model at full information.

production.source: chmoses98/cfb-edge-finder branch projection-data @ 677e10dfe2e79aa39bce902e2dc1a6b441901917, forecasts/cfb/*/*.jsonl.gz (sift.forecast_archive.v1), model_id pf-cfb, families margin (home - away joint distribution), game_total, team_points
production.selection: per game and family, the latest record with generated_utc < cutoff, archived_utc < cutoff and the git commit that added its file < cutoff; cutoff = ESPN kickoff (primary) or kickoff - 4 h (sensitivity). p_home = P(margin > 0) + 0.5 P(margin = 0) from the archived margin distribution. Identity: ESPN game id shared by all sources; home/away ESPN team ids must both have team_points; margin must equal home - away team points when from the same run (241 / 241 checked at kickoff).
production.note: pf-cfb versions are mixed (pf-1.2.1 and 19 pf-1.3.0 builds); production is scored as archived. Production pf-cfb role on the branch is research_only/shadow; the script-engine incumbent is not scored (no win probability, no margin distribution).

fit: season-level walk-forward exactly as discovery.engine: 2026 predicted by ridge fitted on seasons 2014-2025 (lambda chosen on 2025), sigma = RMSE of 2017-2025 out-of-sample residuals; no in-season refit (the study design has none); 2026 outcomes are removed from the fit target. P(home win) = Phi(mu / sigma).
challenger_note: all_certified = the study's preregistered full model; adj_efficiency = its reference; the other five are the groups that passed Holm on the study's test seasons (drive_scoring margin+total, success_rate margin+total, pass_rush_split margin, roster_priors margin), singly and as a union.

primary.test: paired per-game difference (challenger - production), game-level bootstrap (4000 resamples, seed 7), two-sided, Holm across the 3 contrasts, alpha 0.05

secondary: all other challengers, MAE / RMSE / bias for margin and total, log loss, calibration slope, accuracy, home-field check (mean predicted vs actual home margin on non-neutral games, bias on neutral games), ISO-week-clustered CIs, the kickoff - 4 h production table. Descriptive; no multiplicity claim.
interpretation_rule: A challenger is 'better than production' on a family only if the primary Holm p < 0.05 with a negative difference AND the ISO-week-clustered CI and the kickoff - 4 h comparison also exclude 0. Otherwise production is not shown to be worse. Nothing is promoted by this study in any case.
closing_lines: not available for 2026 in the vault (no CFBD lines_* for 2026); no market benchmark is computed for these games and no market data enters any fit.
blend: a 50/50 margin blend of production and all_certified is reported as exploratory only.
